ns2:course.label: Intro to Computing Systems
ns2:course.description: Bits, binary representations, digital logic structures, the von Neumann computing model, an example instruction set, machine and assembly language programming, machine-level input/output, subroutines, the C programming language, variables and operators, control constructs, functions in C, pointers and arrays, input/output in C, recursion, and simple data. Credit is not given for both ECE 190 and CS 125.
